_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.51.1 for access policy checks on joins and column names; beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.70.1, which sends mcp:bridge-ready (this app answers agents 503 without it) and fixes Apply on agent proposals. beamlynx-ui 0.70.1 still needs pine-lang 0.51 (its RequiredVersion).
